lines: Pregame build, kickoff Sun 3:25pm CT. Sold 50, 1,105 resting. Worst line -$45 (goal -$75).

sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: Lagging (75+ behind the leader): DET by 1-6, DET by 7-14, DET by 15+, GB by 1-6, GB by 7-14.
DET by 1-6: 50 behind. Crowd is quiet here (5 traded).
DET by 7-14: 50 behind. Crowd is quiet here (5 traded).
A price step needs 10 min with no fill and the crowd paying less.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A side gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of launch.
Gate open: worst line -$45 is better than -$100.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It trips if the worst line falls under -$150.
Paid balancing starts Sun 2:40pm CT: worst line to -$75 by Sun 3:15pm CT, up to $50.
At Sun 2:55pm CT, if worst line is -$75 or better, paid balancing stops.
Kickoff Sun 3:25pm CT: the in-game engine takes over.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: price steps, new batches and paid balancing run by rule. It will not reprice for line moves or news.
